A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Lantillies system/Legends|Lantillies system]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. The [[Galactic Republic/Legends|galactic Republic]] defeated the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] there.

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It is marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the battles of the Mandalorian Wars rather than described in prose. Due to its placement without any movement arrows pointing to or from it, the battle in the Lantillies sector could have taken place at any time during the Wars.
